title: cheilanthes myriophylla var. elegans
intro: Cheilanthes myriophylla var. elegans, commonly known as the Elegant Ruff-selvia or Ruff-selvia, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes myriophylla var. elegans are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which work to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
